question: Should Crabbox accept this POST-only logout boundary, including the behavior change that GET /portal/logout no longer clears the session?
rationale: The code direction matches the source-backed security report, but it changes a browser auth/session boundary and a previously documented endpoint behavior, which requires maintainer intent beyond CI.

options.title: Accept POST-only logout after proof
options.body: Merge this direction once the contributor adds inspectable redacted runtime proof and removes the release-owned changelog entry.

options.title: Require a token-based confirmation variant
options.body: Ask for an explicit CSRF or intent token instead of relying only on same-origin POST if maintainers want a stronger browser confirmation contract.

options.title: Keep GET logout behavior
options.body: Leave the old endpoint semantics in place only if maintainers explicitly accept the forced-logout availability risk documented in the linked issues.

recommendation.title: Accept POST-only logout after proof
recommendation.body: Merge this direction once the contributor adds inspectable redacted runtime proof and removes the release-owned changelog entry.
